text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, at the station near
Tracen
Academy...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There're so many people here every
single
morning...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look at all the old guys decked out in
suits and
super straight ties...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Until just a little while ago, I was lookin'
down on
them, thinkin' their lives were
so boring. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's amazing. You're all so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Goin' to work in an office every day is
really
something, isn't it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, they go to the same place and
do the
same thing every day, right?
choice_data_list_en: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like only really strong people can
put up
with somethin' like that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The only reason to keep doin' the same
boring
thing over and over is either to
win, or because
you're doin' it for
someone else...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But I can't do that! It's in my blood to
seek
constant stimulation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I see somethin' dazzling, my heart
is drawn
to it, and I immediately wanna
go to it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's my nature. I must've got it from my
pops,
but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I really think about it, it's how I've
always
been.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and I recall all the things that put
a
sparkle in her eye...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Derby... The once-in-a-lifetime
battle I just
couldn't miss. That was so
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The drag race we saw at the summer
camp. Those
guys were so cool, puttin'
everythin' on the line
for just that brief
moment.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Fleeting moments like that steal my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I'm still just a kid inside?
Am I gonna
have to grow out of it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I don't... does that mean, I'm not
gonna be able
to move forward
anymore?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My pops never changed. He may not be
the
greatest in everyone's eyes, but he's
leadin' a cool
life.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I've gotta fall in line in order to go to
higher
places, then...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What am I supposed to do? Do I have to be all mature to compete in senior year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Vodka gets stuck between
strength
and coolness...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the higher the stakes, the
harder it is
to maintain your own style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, Trainer?
choice_data_list: 自分の根は――変えられない
自分の根は――変えられないよ
choice_data_list_en: You can't change who you are at your roots.
You can't change who you are at your roots, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When you're growing up, there are
things that
change and things that don't.
choice_data_list: ウオッカはウオッカのままだから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That passion for cool stuff is such a
fundamental
thing—such a motivating
factor—it's a strength in
and of itself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A strength? Just bein' inspired by cool
stuff?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you sure that's not a
weakness?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I can keep goin' like this if I believe
in my
strength?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give my reassurance. Vodka has to win
in her
own way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If not, she won't be satisfied. She won't
be able to
say she really lived.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y'know... I really am glad you're with me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I start strayin' over to the
beaten path,
you laugh me off of it and
back onto my own trail.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm me! I've gotta keep
goin' the way
I want to.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna beat those office workers, I've
gotta
perfect my own style even more.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I honestly don't even know what
coolness I'm
gonna want to chase next.
But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've just gotta do my best like the outlaw
I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The twinkle that was in Vodka's eyes at
her debut
has finally returned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she can finally see her next
step.
